remarks:
Escape to the beauty of Chautauqua Lake with this charming cottage-style home offering picturesque water views from directly across the lake. Enjoy un-deeded lake rights and dock via the 10 ft. easement down to the lake.  Lake access is located at the end of the road, making it easy to enjoy boating, kayaking, fishing, or a day by the water.  

The spacious open-concept layout creates an inviting atmosphere perfect for entertaining or relaxing after a day on the water. An enclosed sun porch provides the ideal spot to enjoy your morning coffee, unwind with a book, or take in spectacular sunsets over the lake.

Outside, you'll find a large Amish-built shed offering exceptional storage for lake toys, outdoor equipment, and more. Whether you're searching for a year-round residence, a vacation retreat, or an investment opportunity, this home captures the relaxed lake lifestyle you've been dreaming of.

Located in the heart of one of Western New York's premier recreational destinations, you'll enjoy easy access to boating, fishing, kayaking, swimming, and miles of scenic shoreline. Spend your days dining at popular waterfront restaurants while taking in breathtaking lake views, browsing charming boutiques, attending concerts and seasonal festivals, or exploring the renowned Chautauqua Institution just minutes away. Chautauqua Lake is known for its vibrant summer atmosphere, year-round recreation, and unforgettable sunsets, making every day feel like a getaway.
